row.evidence: DemandScience's help centre lists SAML 2.0 SSO (e.g. Okta) as 'Additional subscription required' and documents no SCIM for the platform; only the Email Experiences module syncs employees from Azure AD via a tenant URL and secret token.
row.notes: New row. terminus.com now 301-redirects to DemandScience, which acquired Terminus; the row is named after what is sold today. No public pricing: the pricing FAQ routes buyers to a pipeline audit conversation. Platform logins: Google/Microsoft sign-in on all subscriptions; SAML 2.0/OIDC SSO with other IdPs needs an additional subscription; users are invited and deactivated manually in the Team section. A help-centre search for 'SCIM' returns no articles. The Email Experiences module (formerly Sigstr, signatures) syncs employee records from Azure AD through an Entra non-gallery app with automatic provisioning (Tenant URL plus Secret Token from Integrations; needs Azure AD P1/P2), creates, updates and deletes employees and maps groups; the article never names SCIM and covers only Entra. Email Experiences also has a Google Workspace user import, CSV import and an Employee Automation API enabled by ticket. Status stays unknown: no SCIM is documented for the main platform, and the Entra-only employee sync is not documented as SCIM.

limitations.text: Email Experiences Azure AD sync requires an Azure AD P1 or P2 licence and supports only the fixed attribute mappings.
Employees removed from the Entra provisioning scope are deleted from Email Experiences within 24 hours.

scim.notes: No SCIM article in the DemandScience help centre (search 'SCIM': 0 results). Email Experiences uses Entra automatic provisioning with a Tenant URL and Secret Token (Entra non-gallery provisioning), which implies a SCIM-style endpoint for that module only, but the vendor does not call it SCIM or document it for other IdPs.

limitations.text: Employee Automation API is enabled through a support ticket and covers Email Experiences employee data only.

user_api.notes: An Employee Automation API for Email Experiences creates, updates and removes employee signature records and is enabled by support ticket; no public endpoint reference or platform user-management API was found.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'terminus' and 'demandscience' returned no results. SAML with Okta is configured as a custom app via the add-on subscription.

entra.notes: Gallery app is 'Sigstr' (now Email Experiences), SSO only. Separately, DemandScience documents Email Experiences employee provisioning through an Entra non-gallery app ('Create your own application').

google.notes: Email Experiences offers a vendor-run G Suite user import (first name, last name, group, email); not an IdP catalogue app.

onelogin.notes: Not checked; OneLogin connector pages block bots.
